title: Yuzu Cigar Club | Membership, Storefront, Digital Humidor
description: A premium cigar club storefront with Medusa-ready commerce, adult compliance, memberships, events, and a PWA digital humidor.

cssVariables.--font-sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

headings.text: Premium Cigars by the Box. Curated Membership. Smart Digital Humidor.
A storefront that behaves like a member system.
Manual entry now. QR and sensors next.
